name: Winston Churchill
hook: Britain's wartime prime minister: blood, toil, tears and sweat, an Iron Curtain, and a cigar forever.

facts.label: blood, toil, tears and sweat
facts.statement: In his first statement as prime minister in 1940, Churchill said he had "nothing to offer but blood, toil, tears and sweat."

facts.label: the Iron Curtain
facts.statement: On March 5, 1946, Churchill said an Iron Curtain had "descended across the continent," dividing Eastern Europe from the West.

facts.label: the Boer War
facts.statement: In 1899, in his mid-20s, Churchill was captured and imprisoned during the Boer War, then escaped.

facts.label: Clement Attlee
facts.statement: Clement Attlee led Britain's Labour Party and replaced Churchill as prime minister after the July 1945 election.

facts.label: Blenheim Palace
facts.statement: Churchill was born at Blenheim Palace in Oxfordshire, built for John Churchill, the 1st Duke of Marlborough.

facts.label: Harrow
facts.statement: Churchill attended Harrow, whose alumni also include Lord Byron and Sir Robert Peel, then trained at Sandhurst.

facts.label: his 1965 funeral
facts.statement: Churchill died in 1965; Elizabeth II attended his funeral, the first reigning British monarch to attend a commoner's.
